offices.title: Village President
offices.org_name: Bellows Falls Village Board of Trustees

org_sources.note: Village of Bellows Falls charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 207 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 5 provides for a President and four Trustees, elected at the annual meeting; by section 7 the President is a member of the Board of Trustees and presides over it.

Village of Bellows Falls annual meeting minutes, May 18, 2026, published on the Town of Rockingham / Village of Bellows Falls website (Agendas and Minutes, 2026): the 'Present' list names Paul Obuchowski, Village President, and Wade Masure, Taylor Pichette, Samantha Snow, and Jonathan Wright, Trustees.

Village of Bellows Falls, Village Trustees page (Town of Rockingham website): lists Wade Masure, Taylor Pichette, and Samantha Snow as Trustees but still shows Wendy M. Levy as Village President and Jeff Dunbar as a Trustee. The attested minutes of the May 18, 2026 annual meeting govern; Levy and Dunbar are not recorded.

Village of Bellows Falls charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 207 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 5 provides for a Clerk, elected at the annual meeting.

Village of Bellows Falls annual meeting minutes, May 18, 2026, published on the Town of Rockingham / Village of Bellows Falls website (Agendas and Minutes, 2026): the 'Present' list names Kathleen Kelly, Village Clerk; she attests the minutes as Village Clerk. Kelly is also the Rockingham Town Clerk.

Village of Bellows Falls charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 207 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 5 provides for a Moderator, elected at the annual meeting; section 9 states the Moderator's duties.

Village of Bellows Falls annual meeting minutes, May 18, 2026, published on the Town of Rockingham / Village of Bellows Falls website (Agendas and Minutes, 2026): the 'Present' list names Dennis Harty, Moderator, and the minutes are approved over his name as Moderator.

Village of Bellows Falls charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 207 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 5 provides for a Treasurer, elected at the annual meeting. No village page names the current Treasurer, so no holder is recorded.
